Technical Support Engineer – On-site (Kfar Saba)
Job Type: Full-time position
Location: On-site – at our offices in Kfar Saba, Israel
Position Overview: We are looking for a proactive and customer-oriented Technical Support Engineer (L1/L2) to join our team in Kfar Saba. This role combines hands-on customer support (Level 1 & 2) with technical troubleshooting and QA involvement.
You will be the main point of contact for customers in Europe and Israel, and also serve as a backup for the US support team, ensuring excellent service while contributing to product quality and continuous improvement.
You will play a key role in customer satisfaction and product quality, acting as the bridge between customers and our product. Your work will directly impact how customers experience NoviSign and how our platform continues to improve.

Responsibilities:
Customer Support & Communication
• Provide excellent support via email, chat, phone, and video calls
• Guide customers, demonstrate the system, and solve issues in real time
• Ensure a high-quality support experience and strong customer satisfaction
Technical Troubleshooting (L1/L2)
• Investigate and resolve technical issues end-to-end
• Analyze logs, use internal tools, and perform basic database queries
• Reproduce issues and document findings clearly
QA & Product Involvement
• Take part in QA activities and collaborate with QA and development teams
• Validate fixes and support testing (regression, sanity checks)
• Identify recurring issues and contribute to product improvements
Documentation & AI Tools
• Maintain and improve technical documentation and knowledge base
• Use AI tools to enhance support efficiency and workflows

Requirements:
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills — must enjoy working directly with customers
• Very good English and Hebrew (written & spoken) — both are required
• Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills
• Ability to understand complex systems and explain them clearly
• Experience with support tools, CRM systems, or ticketing systems
• Familiarity with QA processes and bug tracking tools
• Basic SQL knowledge (e.g., MySQL) — advantage
• Ability to read logs and troubleshoot issues
• High attention to detail and strong documentation skills
• Proactive mindset and ability to work independently

Additional Details:
• Full-time, on-site position (Kfar Saba)
• Availability to work on Fridays and holidays as needed

 
UI/UX Product Designer (Freelance – ~50%)
Job Type: Partial position
Location: Remote – with one day per week at our office in Kfar Saba, Israel
Position Overview: We are looking for a UI/UX Product Designer to join our team on a freelance basis (~50% position).
You will help design and improve the user experience of NoviSign’s B2B SaaS digital signage platform, used by organizations around the world to create, manage, and broadcast digital content to screens.
We are looking for a fast executor who can turn ideas into clean, scalable user interfaces and help evolve our product design.
Experience using modern AI tools for design workflows and UI generation is a strong advantage.

Responsibilities:
• Design intuitive UI/UX for complex SaaS workflows and multiple product screens
• Translate product requirements into clear, scalable UI solutions
• Work closely with product managers and developers to implement new features
• Maintain consistency across the product using a structured Design System
• Rapidly prototype ideas and iterate based on feedback

Requirements:
• Proven experience designing SaaS / B2B products
• Experience designing complex systems with multiple screens and deep information architecture
• Strong proficiency in Figma (Components, Variants, Auto Layout, Prototyping)
• Experience building or maintaining a Design System
• Ability to execute quickly and deliver high-quality UI designs
• Experience using AI design tools as part of the design workflow

Sales Development Representative

What We Offer:
• Competitive salary
• Opportunities for career growth and advancement
• Ongoing training and professional development
• Flexible work environment

Channel Sales Manager U.S.A. (remote)
Job Type: Full time
Location: Remote
Position Overview: As a Channel Sales Manager USA, you will be responsible for developing and managing our channel partner business across the Americas, with a focus on North America. You will identify, recruit, and nurture relationships with key channel partners, driving sales growth through these partnerships. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a proven track record in channel sales and a deep understanding of the SaaS industry. Past experience within the digital signage market is an advantage.

Responsibilities:
• Develop and execute a comprehensive channel sales strategy
• Identify, approach and recruit new channel partners, including resellers, distributors, and system integrators
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential channel partners
• Collaborate with partners to develop joint business plans, sales strategies, and marketing initiatives
• Provide training and support to partners to ensure they are equipped to sell our offering effectively
• Monitor and analyze partner performance, providing regular feedback and guidance to optimize results. Perform QBRs with key partners
• Work closely with internal teams, including marketing, product, and customer success, to align strategies and ensure a seamless partner experience
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and competitive landscape to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (MBA is a plus)
• 3+ years of experience in channel sales, preferably in the SaaS industry
• Proven track record of successfully developing and managing channel partner programs
• Strong understanding of the US market and channel sales ecosystem
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to drive decision-making
• Willingness to travel as needed
• Past experience within the digital signage industry – a big advantage

What We Offer:
• Competitive salary
• Performance-based bonuses
• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Flexible working configuration option
• A collaborative and inclusive work environment
• The chance to be part of an innovative and growing company

Telesales Agent

Job Type: Full time
Location: Lviv (Ukraine)

Job Description
We are looking for a Telesales Agent that will be responsible for contacting customers, generating interest, offering information, obtaining customer feedback, and producing leads. The role of telemarketing is to create sales prospects, while telesales converts the opportunities into sales and repeat buyers of a company’s products or services.

Requirements:
• Providing potential customer customers with information about the software to create interest in the brand
• Helping sales teams identify and qualify potential sales leads
• Providing reliable and actionable data to support the telesales team to increase efficiency and productivity
• Pre-qualifying prospects to make the work of sales teams easier
• Generating repeat business by promoting new offers to customers
• Converting customer inquiries into sales opportunities
• Providing market research through outbound calling

Additional Position Details:
Lead generation
Contact potential and existing customers by phone to inform them of their company’s products, services, and offers. The agent will also receive phone calls from people responding to direct marketing and advertising campaigns.

Direct sales
Besides creating awareness about products or services, the representative will perform direct sales functions. Working with the sales team, they can use the data from previous sales to target customers for repeat business. Telesales agents can also ask promising leads qualifying questions that can help reveal their willingness to buy.

Take and process orders
Telesales agents take and process orders to meet sales quotas. They manage repeat purchases, which provides opportunities to cross-sell existing customers. When customers place new orders, agents use scripts to offer additional products or services based on past purchasing behavior. This helps to boost sales and profits and allows the sales team to concentrate on selling in the field.

Customer service
Excellent customer service delivery is part of a telesales agent’s duties. To encourage customers to continue buying from their company, agents call them after a sale to ensure they are satisfied with the product or service. They also collect, compile and update customer records in a database, making it vital to have excellent typing and telephone skills.
Telesales agents also inform customers of new offers based on their preferences and needs. Their customer service duties are to provide accurate information about the company, its products or services, promotions, and other details. This makes it crucial for telesales agents to have in-depth knowledge of their organization and its offers.

Activity reports
An effective telesales agent will also create and update activity reports. The reports cover the number of calls, leads, customers, sales, and other vital statistics that can help increase revenue.

Meet sales goals
Telesales representatives need to meet monthly and quarterly sales goals according to the company’s revenue targets. In addition, they must make a minimum number of calls and close a specific number of sales that moves them closer to their quotas.
